what: How the kernel shows an MCP server started out of a `pip install --user` installation, read while `agentic-hil upgrade` ran beside it: the system interpreter as the image, the installation's console script as the second argument of the `#!` line the kernel ran, and no VIRTUAL_ENV, because a user installation has no environment of its own. It is the installation the quick start's `python -m pip install --user agentic-hil` line makes, and `agentic-hil upgrade` named nobody under `restart_required_by` for it.
how: agentic-hil 0.21.6.dev0 installed with `python -m pip install --user agentic-hil` into an account of its own made from Debian's /etc/skel, from the package index tools/bench/Dockerfile builds into the bench image (python:3.12-slim by digest, rootless container), on a Linux bench. The server is `agentic-hil mcp-stdio` started through the launcher the account's agent registrations name, holding the board through a COM session, and it is read out of /proc/<pid>/exe, cmdline, environ and cwd. `interpreter` is what that interpreter says about itself, `scripts_beside` is the user scheme's script directory after the install, and `upgrade` is the manager and command `agentic-hil upgrade --json` answered with. The account's home directory is replaced by <home>; nothing else is changed.
